definitions.gloss: nighttime, at night, during the night
definitions.explanation: Refers to the period of time between evening and morning when it is dark.

examples.japanese: {夜間|やかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{夜間|やかん}⟦{通行止|つうこうど}め→通行止め：19920_tsuukoudome⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: This road is closed at night.

notes:
{夜間|やかん} is a somewhat formal term for nighttime, used especially in compound expressions, signs, and official contexts. More formal than ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧ (everyday word for night).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夜間|やかん}⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧: operating at night
- {夜間|やかん}⟦{勤務|きんむ}→勤務：04545_kinmu⟧: night shift
- {夜間|やかん}⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧: night school
- {夜間|やかん}⟦{飛行|ひこう}→飛行：03578_hikou⟧: night flight
- {夜間|やかん}⟦{診療|しんりょう}→診療：14183_shinryou⟧: nighttime medical care

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧: night (general, everyday)
- {夜間|やかん}: nighttime (formal/official)
- ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧: late night, after midnight
- ⟦{夜中|よなか}→夜中：01008_yonaka⟧: middle of the night
- ⟦{昼間|ひるま}→昼間：01713_hiruma⟧: daytime (opposite)
